segments.name: Mobileye
segments.description: Develops and sells EyeQ™ SoCs and SuperVision™ systems for driver assistance and autonomous driving to automotive suppliers and carmakers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company's organizational structure and management reporting supports two operating segments: Mobileye and Moovit.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Moovit, a mobility-as-a-service company, provides urban mobility applications and navigation data to consumers and is reported within Other.
segments.evidence: Mobileye is presented as a reportable operating segment and Moovit, which is a mobility-as-a-service company, is presented within "Other" as per ASC 280, Segment Reporting.

revenueModel.text: Automotive suppliers pay Mobileye for EyeQ™ SoCs and SuperVision™ systems, which they integrate into vehicles for carmakers.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the majority of our revenue from the sale of our EyeQ™ SoCs to OEMs primarily through sales to Tier 1 automotive suppliers that implement our product into vehicles, in which case our direct customer is the Tier 1 automotive supplier that is responsible for paying us for our products.
